what_this_is: The Workshop rows for tools/see-what-my-business-took-in-this-month: Business's one read (tool:read-business) and the Stripe money read it runs with the person's own connection.

payload.label: Read this account's business this month
payload.job: Read what this account's business took in this month on the payment services it connected
payload.description: The one read of the Business screen (tool:business). Returns since_words (the first of this month), service_names (the payment services whose money can be read), connected ([{label, state: read | none | unread, currencies: [{currency, code, multi, service_label, money_in, fees, refunded, net}] written in each currency, payments, more, at_most}], one per payment service, each read with this account's own connection by running its money read, tool:stripe-events-read_money_since; a read that fails is unread, with no number) and operator (null: the operator's part has no owner here). Which services this account connected cannot be read today, so each is read and a failed read says the money could not be read. Reads only.

now.description: The time whose month is read (ISO); now when left out

provenance.source: trillion src/business-screen.mjs readBusiness (the account action read-business, catalogue row tool:read-business in records/marketplace-screens.json), before 4ffa1dc4a2

payload.label: Read the money on my Stripe account since a moment
payload.job: List the money that moved on this Stripe account since a moment, newest first, at most 100 entries
payload.description: Lists what moved this Stripe account's balance at or after `since` (seconds since 1970, UTC), newest first, at most 100 entries: Stripe's own answer ({ data: [balance transactions, each with amount, fee and net in the currency's smallest unit, currency and reporting_category], has_more }), read with this account's own Stripe connection. Business's read (tool:read-business) sums it. Reads only.

since.description: The moment to list from, in seconds since 1970 (UTC)

provenance.source: old trillion's row of the same id, made from this record's instrument_requests.read_money_since by the tool-row-source source:how-to-ask-something-else-to-do-things (tools/connect-a-service-and-seal-its-key/from-old-trillion/records/workshop-tool-records.json); `hosts` binds the key to Stripe's API host, as the engine requires of every key (F-0803)
